commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.
90+4' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+4' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Timo Horn comes off his line to intercept the corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
88' Dieter Hecking prepares a substitution. Maximilian Wittek is replaced by Erhan Masovic (Bochum).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anthony Losilla (Bochum) replaces Matus Bero.
87' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

85' A precise low pass is received by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.

83' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Jonas Urbig to get hold of the ball.
82' That's the end of the game for Felix Passlack, who is replaced by Cristian Gamboa (Bochum).
80' Timo Horn (Bochum) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
80' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' Timo Horn makes a difficult save to deny Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), who attempted to score with a header from inside the box. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
77' Neat passing move from Bochum in order to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) replacing Hiroki Ito.
73' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
73' Georgios Masouras goes off the pitch and Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) comes on.
71' 2 - 3 Goal! Matus Bero (Bochum) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 2:3.
69' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
68' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

68' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Timo Horn.
66' Bayern Munich control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
63' The referee signals a substitution. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Serge Gnabry.
63' Here comes a substitution. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Sacha Boey.
63' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) replaces Leroy Sane.
62' Substitution. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in, Thomas Muller out.
62' Bayern Munich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

62' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
60' Matus Bero (Bochum) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Bochum force a corner. They send men into the box.
59' Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

58' Serge Gnabry rounds off a good move with a layoff to Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
56' Bernardo (Bochum) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
55' The resulting set piece from Bayern Munich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' 4:8 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
54' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
53' Bochum are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
51' 2 - 2 Goal! Felix Passlack picks out Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) with a perfect cross, and he has no problem to nod the ball into an empty net. It's 2:2.
50' Bernardo (Bochum) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
50' Bochum control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
42' Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) can have an early bath after being sent off by the referee for a tackle that simply has no place in football!
41' Shots on target – 3:1.
40' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
38' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
36' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Serge Gnabry, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
34' Neat passing move from Bayern Munich in order to create new attacking opportunities.
31' 2 - 1 Jakov Medic (Bochum) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes into the top of the net.
31' The linesman makes the right call and Bochum will have a corner.
28' 2 - 0 Goal! Thomas Muller puts the ball on the head of Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich), who has the easy task to score into an empty net. 2:0.
27' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

24' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
23' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:0.
22' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
22' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!
21' Jakov Medic (Bochum) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
21' Jakov Medic (Bochum) commits a rough foul. Christian Dingert stops the game and makes a call. That's a penalty to Bayern Munich! They have a good chance to score now.
20' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayern Munich.
19' A dangerous looking corner kick from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is cleared to safety by the defence.

18' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) will take the corner.
18' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
16' Bayern Munich enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
14' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Serge Gnabry laid the ball off to Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich), who shot from close range into the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
13' The percentage of ball possession is – 87:13.
12' A corner kick by Bochum is thwarted by the well prepared Jonas Urbig (Bayern Munich).
10' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
10' The Bayern Munich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich) is penalised for holding. Christian Dingert signals a set piece.
5' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
5' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
2' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
